name: Thunderbolts (AVV)
body:
School evocation (electricity); Level druid (avv) 9, priestess (avv) 9, sorcerer (avv) /wizard (avv) 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./lvl)
Area four 40-ft.- radius spreads, see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none or Reflex half, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you cast thunderbolts, you hurl up to four 10-foot-long javelins of lightning, which streak in straight, sparking lines to the spots you select.

If you aim a javelin at a specific creature, you may make a ranged touch attack to strike the target with the bolt. Any creature struck by a bolt takes 2d6 points of piercing damage (no save) and takes a –4 penalty on the saving throw against the javelin‘s electricity damage (see below). If a targeted bolt misses its target, it simply explodes at the nearest corner of the target’s space. You may aim more than one bolt at the same target.

Once a bolt reaches its destination, it explodes in a 40-foot-radius spread, dealing 6d6 points of electricity damage to each creature in the area. If a creature is within the area of more than one bolt, it must save separately against each. Despite stemming from separate bolts, all of the electricity damage is added together after the saves have been made, and electricity resistance is applied only once.
